text.description_html:
Falcon D251, Double Thumbturn Door Lock

This Non-Keyed Double Thumbturn Deadbolt is for doors where you want to be able to secure the door closed, but also want a thumbturn on each side so a key does not have to be used to unlock and lock the door. It meets ADA requirements. It has an adjustable latch to fit 2-3/8" or 2-3/4" backsets; and it will fit door thicknesses ranging from 1-3/8" up to 1-7/8". Available in Satin Chrome or Matte Black finish.

Features and Specifications of the D251 Turn x Turn Deadbolt:

  • Deadbolt: 1-1/8" x 2-1/4", Square corner faceplate, 1" housing diameter, 1" throw
  • Strike: 1-1/8" x 2-3/4", lipless
  • Trim Ring: 1"
  • Projection Off Door: 3/4" both sides
  • Door Thickness: will fit 1-3/8" - 1-7/8"
  • Backset: adjustable for 2-3/8" or 2-3/4"
  • Metal dust box with three - 3" screws
  • BHMA - ANSI A156.5, 200
  • ADA Compliant

Sold Individually
